title: Ravina bar Sisi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Yalkut, Job, section 923, saying, “Sometimes the world and all it contains cannot hold the glory of His divinity; sometimes He speaks to a person from between the hairs of his head.” Bereshit Rabbah 4:4 reads Rabbi Chanina bar Isi.

notes.text: The complete Bereshit Rabbah locator is 4:4. The two extremes of the divine-speech comparison and the alternate name Chanina bar Isi are preserved.
